levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «ويقال له: معاذ بن مسلم الهراء» gives the same man another name: one link, written with the first name («معاذ بن كثير»); the alias is not a second link
«أبي» is the compiler's father (relation); the four co-transmitters meet at «جميعا قالوا»
the Imam after «عن» is an ordinary narrator link, and the saying is his words
